reason: The study geometrically analyzes finite-step failures in looped Transformers and identifies recoverable utility losses within recurrent inference steps. The full text defines looping as an inference-time compute resource and tests interventions on path direction/step count, but reports no latency or serving-efficiency result and proposes no resource-saving deployment method; retain as adjacent analysis only.
title: Right Direction, Wrong Step: Geometric Analysis of Finite-Step Failure in Looped Transformers
